name: Northern house mosquito
taxon_or_system: Culex pipiens
habitat_context: urban/suburban/rural; stagnant water, catch basins, ditches, containers
seasonality: twilight activity; Ohio warm-season activity; overwintering/diapause context
notes: Ohio source describes widespread occurrence; this is presence and ecology context, not abundance.

name: Culex pipiens/restuans complex context
taxon_or_system: Culex pipiens plus close relative Culex restuans
habitat_context: temperate urban, suburban, rural, and wet/ditch interfaces
seasonality: seasonal mosquito activity; taxon-level surveillance may differ by program
notes: The project retains the complex as a surveillance/ecology context and does not combine species into a pseudo-abundance measure.

name: Asian tiger mosquito
taxon_or_system: Aedes albopictus
habitat_context: vegetated urban edges; artificial and natural containers; tires and gutters
seasonality: day activity, especially shade; warm-season container lifecycle
notes: Ohio and Indiana sources document regional presence/context; county records are not a precise Western Basin distribution.

name: Asian bush mosquito
taxon_or_system: Aedes japonicus
habitat_context: natural and artificial container habitats; forest/stream settings in study sources
notes: Wooster Ohio and Michigan study evidence is retained as regional context, not a local Western Basin range claim.

name: Eastern treehole mosquito
taxon_or_system: Aedes triseriatus
habitat_context: wooded areas, treeholes, parks, and artificial containers
seasonality: day activity in shady wooded settings
notes: Ohio source describes distribution and habitat; no abundance or disease-incidence inference is made.

name: Blacklegged tick
taxon_or_system: Ixodes scapularis
habitat_context: grass/shrub questing and host-associated forest/edge interface
seasonality: spring, summer, fall; adults may quest above freezing in winter
notes: County status rows below use the CDC 2023 summary; established status is a threshold-based surveillance classification, not abundance.

name: American dog tick
taxon_or_system: Dermacentor variabilis
habitat_context: grass/shrub and terrestrial edge context
seasonality: highest biting context in spring and summer
notes: CDC documents broad eastern distribution; no core-county D. variabilis status table is asserted here.

name: Western Basin wetland and standing-water interface
taxon_or_system: wetland and standing-water systems
habitat_context: wetlands, ponds, ditches, temporary and permanent water
notes: Generalized accepted wetland context anchor; it is not a vector collection location or detection.

name: Urban and container habitat interface
taxon_or_system: artificial containers and developed edges
habitat_context: artificial containers, catch basins, gutters, tires, household and developed edges
notes: Habitat class is generalized; no parcel, block, container inventory, or local abundance is modeled.

name: Forest and edge host interface
taxon_or_system: woodland edge, grasses, shrubs, treeholes, and hosts
habitat_context: woodland edge, grass, shrubs, treeholes, small-mammal and deer host interface
seasonality: spring through fall tick context; shaded mosquito context
notes: Broad host-seeking and habitat interface; no exact movement route or sensitive host location.

name: Agricultural, ditch, and floodplain water interface
taxon_or_system: ditches, temporary water, floodplain, and drainage-altered landscape
habitat_context: ditches, temporary water, floodplain and drainage-altered landscape
notes: A generalized hydrology-to-habitat interface; no flood footprint or mosquito abundance is assigned.

name: Vertebrate host ecology context
taxon_or_system: birds, small mammals, deer, domestic animals, and humans
habitat_context: birds, small mammals, deer, domestic animals, and humans as distinct host contexts
notes: Host ecology supports lifecycle context; host presence is not contact, infection, or disease.

name: Temperature and seasonal development interface
taxon_or_system: temperature, humidity, photoperiod, and freeze/thaw
habitat_context: temperature, humidity, photoperiod, freeze/thaw
notes: Temperature relationship is a qualitative interface; no thermal suitability or future range model is created.

name: Precipitation and hydrology interface
taxon_or_system: rainfall, standing water, flow, wetlands, and drainage
habitat_context: rainfall, standing water, flow, wetland and drainage conditions
notes: Hydrology is linked qualitatively to habitat opportunity; no continuous habitat surface or causal count is estimated.

name: Ohio vector surveillance program
taxon_or_system: Ohio Department of Health, laboratory, local public-health, and sanitary-district partners
habitat_context: Ohio Department of Health, laboratory, local public-health and sanitary-district partners
notes: Program and pooled results are retained as surveillance records with effort and scale limits.

name: Michigan arbovirus surveillance program
taxon_or_system: MDHHS, local health departments, laboratories, and partners
habitat_context: MDHHS, local health departments, laboratories and partners
notes: Participating jurisdictions and methods vary; counts are not a statewide abundance index.

name: Indiana mosquito-borne activity surveillance
taxon_or_system: Indiana Department of Health and local surveillance
habitat_context: Indiana Department of Health and local surveillance
seasonality: warm-season activity through hard freeze context
notes: State/county surveillance context; species, effort, and human cases remain separate.

name: CDC ArboNET and tick surveillance interface
taxon_or_system: ArboNET, NNDSS, county tick-status, and pathogen-surveillance products
habitat_context: ArboNET, NNDSS, county tick-status and pathogen-surveillance products
notes: CDC programs maintain separate vector, pathogen, animal, and human records; no combined index is created.

name: West Nile virus pathogen-in-vector context
taxon_or_system: West Nile virus in mosquito-pool and other surveillance streams
habitat_context: West Nile virus in mosquito-pool and other surveillance streams
notes: A positive vector pool is not a human case, contact, infection, clinical disease, or proof of local transmission.

name: Tickborne pathogen surveillance context
taxon_or_system: selected pathogens in host-seeking Ixodes ticks
habitat_context: selected pathogens in host-seeking Ixodes ticks
notes: Pathogen-in-tick status is distinct from tick presence, human contact, infection, disease, and county-of-residence cases.
